elements.name: Retain command sort order across category switches until the dialog closes

steps.name: ribbon customization is open in the MCAD Software with All Commands selected
the available commands are in ascending name order
the user clicks the available-command Name header
the separator remains first and the commands appear in descending name order
the user selects the Sketch Tab command category
the separator remains first and the Sketch commands appear in descending name order
the user selects All Commands again
the available commands remain in descending name order
the user closes customization without making an edit and reopens it from Tools
All Commands is selected and the available commands are in ascending name order
